I’m not ready to accept it yet because two approved behaviors are not fully delivered:

- “Select all” currently selects only the bookmarks loaded in the visible page, and bulk actions send only those individual selections. I need “select all matching” to apply to the entire current search or filter, including results beyond the current page.
- A preserved page described as successful must be genuinely self-contained. If it still relies on external image, style, or font addresses, it may break when the original site disappears. Either embed those resources, or clearly mark the preservation as incomplete or failed rather than presenting it as a successful self-contained copy.

These are implementation corrections against the approved specification. Please fix them and return the updated app with verification covering both cases.
